checks.text: The page heading reads "Baby Activity Log" and, with no entries, the list area shows the text "No activities yet".

From the empty page, selecting "Feeding" in the field labelled "Type", typing "120" in "Duration (min)", typing "Bottle" in "Notes", and clicking the button "Add activity" adds one list item whose text contains "Feeding", "2h 0m", and "Bottle"; the text "No activities yet" is gone.
From the empty page, selecting "Sleep" in "Type", typing "45" in "Duration (min)", and clicking "Add activity" adds one list item whose text contains "Sleep" and "45m".
From the empty page, selecting "Diaper" in "Type" and clicking "Add activity" without a duration adds one list item whose text contains "Diaper" and "—".

After adding the Feeding (120, Bottle), Sleep (45) and Diaper (no duration) entries as in A2-A4, clicking the filter button "Feeding" leaves exactly one list item (the one containing "Feeding" and "2h 0m"); the list items for Sleep and Diaper are not present.
After A5's steps, clicking the filter button "All" shows exactly three list items: one containing "Feeding", one containing "Sleep", one containing "Diaper".
After adding the three entries, clicking the button "Delete Feeding" removes the Feeding item; exactly two list items remain, containing "Sleep" and "Diaper".

After adding the Feeding entry (120, Bottle), clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file whose first line is "type,timestamp,duration,notes" and whose second line contains "Feeding" and "Bottle".
After adding the Sleep entry (45), reloading the page still shows a list item containing "Sleep" and "45m".
